title: Rehearsal Before the Season

palette.why: The marine world earns blue as water and laboratory enamel, while mango and bright daylight carry research curiosity. Mint denotes the model boundary, never success. Both favorable and unfavorable outcomes receive identical high-contrast lettering. This differs from September 13 oxblood porcelain petrol copper nickel and September 12 lilac ivory citron coral violet.

light.direction: Hard key from upper left, cool water fill from below, thin alabaster rim on the right edge
light.depth: Three or more Stage3D planes per shot. Rim and form gradients separate the mango grip from enamel; contact shadows pin controls and researchers to their supports. Harbor piles in foreground pass faster than distant buildings. Window reflections are clipped to their glass.
light.why: Transparent model boundaries must remain tangible, and a visible full-size harbor must dwarf the bounded research apparatus without turning into a gloomy warning.

shape_language.grammar: Rounded articulated hands and control grips meet rectilinear experiment bays. Identical comparison windows and labels prevent higher catch from being declared the winner. Biological content uses labeled unscaled model outlines, never a relabeled species.
shape_language.why: The learned rule explores an explicitly constructed system; biological assumptions are separate hardware in the illustration, not a magical ocean transformation.

hero.why: Existing longThrow control makes candidate adjustment visible. A mango grip and serial notch keep the same research control recognizable through all acts. It controls only illustrated simulations.

support.why: One fictional researcher operates the control, resets distinct experiments and sets both rules onto the next test. Driven gestures only; no idle spectator.
Close shots show continuous hand-to-grip contact using a shared pivot-derived anchor, not independently tuned coordinates.

support.asset: Stage3D, Plane, CameraMoves, ContactShadow, RimLight, MotionBlur
support.why: Use shared depth, shade and motion machinery for coherent physical contact and scale change.
Give each experiment its own distinct learned and predefined candidates. Keep unresolved next-test space visibly separate from reported findings.

casting.net_new_reason: The selected verdict uses the existing GearLever and tokens. No new fish or competing hero is needed; spend craft effort on contact and material finish.

motion_language.primary: Lever anticipates, sweeps an 80-degree arc and settles at a physical detent. A connected schematic path carries outcomes back into candidate adjustment. The predefined control stays fixed during learning. Distinct bays reset and reconnect before the second result.
motion_language.secondary: Lever collar and cable lag the sweep, research sleeves follow the hand, window waterlines ripple, harbor lines sway from attached cleats.
motion_language.events: At least one literal physical verb every 3 to 5 seconds. Moving parts illustrate the current line. No particle motion used to impersonate content. Freeze all scene clocks during three 0.6-second reveal holds.
motion_language.why: The story is a sequence of controlled experiments. Motion must make the feedback and reset legible before it provides ornament.
motion_language.blur: Use shared MotionBlur at180-degree shutter-equivalent on the fast lever throw and59s doorway wipe. Blur only physical movers; labels, source scope and captions remain sharp. Reveal holds pause primary, camera, reactions, ambient and reflections together.

stages: Bright wet laboratory with glazed observation bays and steel ribs
Separate stock-linked experimental room with tiled floor, curved glazing and overhead feed pipe
Open harbor comparison bench with full-size quay, buildings and water
heights: low at control pivot and quay edge
composition.safe_area: Keep all essential illustrated results in x90 to990 and y530 to1240 of1080x1920. Reserve y1336 to1468 for captions. Both the1080-square crop from y420 and portrait retain the argument. Sparse fixed study attribution above the caption band.
composition.signature_shot: A low-angle pullback reveals both candidate rules on the same next-test bench, with the whole harbor extending beyond the model boundary. The discovery survives while its claim narrows.
composition.hierarchy: One controlling action at center per shot. Labels arrive attached to the result they name. Never stack competing full-size information panels.
composition.stage_rule: The mechanism cutaway is a framing of the first laboratory, not a third stage. Each of the three rooms/exterior has a genuinely different architecture and physical layout.

label_treatment.colors: Ink navy #152342 text on alabaster #EFF5E9 for every outcome, reverse pairing for scope only. Mango belongs to grip/accent material, never text on alabaster.
label_treatment.sizes: Outcome text48px minimum, case headers40px, versus-its-comparison qualifiers32px, source scope28px, captions39px. Long labels wrap to at most two lines; no compressed type.
label_treatment.segregation: Study and case scope at1250, captions1336to1468, source proper names get their own narrated full-size scene rather than micro print.
label_treatment.minimum_contrast: 12 to1 for outcome text/substrate, measured in code before probes.

reveal_holds.subject: completed outcome-feedback circuit
reveal_holds.negative_space: Outer apparatus retracts from the upper right so one returning feedback path owns the gap.

reveal_holds.subject: the newly separate stock-linked room
reveal_holds.negative_space: Door leaves clear center around new control station; old case remains in a narrow distant doorway.

reveal_holds.subject: supported equal-test bench beneath the harbor
reveal_holds.negative_space: Sky and water open around the small research bench while full-size quay piles establish scale.

composition.portrait_depth: Above420 show real room rafters, windows, pipes or harbor sky and cranes. Below1500 show attached bench legs, room floor seams or near quay edge and mooring shadows. These planes give portrait scale and occlusion, not duplicated information or blank bands.

craft_advance.system: GearLever contact geometry and material articulation
craft_advance.change: Expose one shared grip-center transform derived from the exact pivot and throw used to draw the lever; use it for GripHand and contact timing. Add opt-in service detail with a shaded base, detents, bolts and a restrained collar reaction to give close shots dimensional material information. Existing defaults preserve old films.
craft_advance.proof: Numerically check endpoint and midpoint contact geometry, then inspect consecutive-frame grip-contact strips across the actual throw.

guardrails: Illustrated physical apparatus is a schematic of software experiments, not equipment claimed by the paper.
No plotted values or counts. Qualitative outcome arrows and words only.
No smoothness detour and no claim of steadier catches.
Separate constant and stock-linked simulated experiments, each relative to its comparison.
